dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A man fell off his motorcycle. I'm on Silom Road, in front of the bank.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈmæn ˈfɛl ˈɔːf hɪz ˈmoʊtərsaɪkəl. aɪm ɑːn ˈsiːlɑːm ˈroʊd, ɪn ˈfrʌnt əv ðə ˈbæŋk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: OK. I'm sending an ambulance now. Is he breathing?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪm ˈsɛndɪŋ ən ˈæmbjələns ˈnaʊ. ɪz hiː ˈbriːðɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, he's breathing, but he isn't moving.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, hiːz ˈbriːðɪŋ, bʌt hiː ˈɪzənt ˈmuːvɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Make sure he doesn't move. He might hurt his neck.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪk ˈʃʊr hiː ˈdʌzənt ˈmuːv. hiː maɪt ˈhɜːrt hɪz ˈnɛk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Some people want to take off his helmet.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. sʌm ˈpiːpəl ˈwɑːnt tə ˈteɪk ˈɔːf hɪz ˈhɛlmɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No! Make sure no one takes off his helmet.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ! ˈmeɪk ˈʃʊr ˈnoʊ ˈwʌn ˈteɪks ˈɔːf hɪz ˈhɛlmɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Should I give him first aid?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ʃʊd aɪ ˈɡɪv hɪm ˈfɜːrst ˈeɪd?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Only if you know how. Just stay calm, and make sure he stays warm.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊnli ɪf juː ˈnoʊ ˈhaʊ. dʒʌst ˈsteɪ ˈkɑːm, ənd ˈmeɪk ˈʃʊr hiː ˈsteɪz ˈwɔːrm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. I'll stay with him. Please hurry!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪl ˈsteɪ wɪð hɪm. ˈpliːz ˈhɜːri!
